comments.body: This is now on Captain's Ticket, can someone share here what ornaments has inside? please, thank you.

comments.author: Blake.C
comments.body:
According to the Japanese wiki:

Halloween Pumpkin
Globe
History Book
Hibiscus
Long Case Clock
Tanabata Decoration
Treasure Ship
Ipomoea nil
Daruma
Bonsai
Kadomatsu

Since I G.T. these names and a few didn't quite match what was on Ivryo I made an educated guess of what best matched (and I refuse to spend money on those Captain's Tickets), so I could be wrong on one or two of them.

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: Thank you Blake.C, It has nice oenaments

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body:
I managed to snag one of these, and it turns out I was wrong on the last 3 in particular. Instead of Daruma, Bonsai, and Kadomatsu, it's Uchikake, Maple, and Inner Garden (I dont have access to my old Ivyro account anymore!).

Some of these have really nice Ornament display effects you cant get anywhere else. So dont recycle or sell them thoughtlessly.

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
This comes back as Monthly's Bonus Quest Reward from 3rd October (after maintenance) - 28th November, so it will be a quite long time.

For those who don't spend real cash just to snag this, it's your time buddy
